import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
sleep_disorder_colors = {'Insomnia': '#e74c3c', 'Sleep Apnea': '#3498db', 'NaN': '#2ecc71'}
df['Sleep Disorder Fill'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
for disorder in df['Sleep Disorder Fill'].unique():
    mask = df['Sleep Disorder Fill'] == disorder
    ax1.scatter(df[mask]['Sleep Duration'], df[mask]['Quality of Sleep'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=80, label=disorder, edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', frameon=True, shadow=True)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Average Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values()
colors_occ = plt.cm.viridis(np.linspace(0.2, 0.9, len(occupation_sleep)))
occupation_sleep.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax2, color=colors_occ)
ax2.set_xlabel('Avg Sleep Duration (hrs)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('')
ax2.set_title('Avg Sleep Duration\nby Occupation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=8)
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Physical Activity vs Stress Level
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
scatter = ax3.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Stress Level'], 
                     c=df['Sleep Duration'], cmap='RdYlGn', s=60, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.5)
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress\n(colored by Sleep Duration)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax3)
cbar.set_label('Sleep Duration (hrs)', fontsize=9)
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 4. BMI Category Distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
colors_bmi = ['#e74c3c', '#f39c12', '#2ecc71', '#3498db']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(bmi_counts, labels=bmi_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                     colors=colors_bmi[:len(bmi_counts)], startangle=90,
                                     explode=[0.05]*len(bmi_counts))
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
    autotext.set_fontsize(10)
ax4.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)

# 5. Sleep Quality by Gender and Age Group
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
df['Age Group'] = pd.cut(df['Age'], bins=[0, 30, 40, 50, 100], labels=['<30', '30-40', '40-50', '50+'])
sleep_gender_age = df.groupby(['Age Group', 'Gender'])['Quality of Sleep'].mean().unstack()
sleep_gender_age.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax5, color=['#e91e63', '#2196f3'], width=0.7)
ax5.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Avg Quality of Sleep', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Sleep Quality by\nAge Group & Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax5.legend(title='Gender', frameon=True)
ax5.set_xticklabels(ax5.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax5.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 6. Heart Rate Distribution by Sleep Disorder
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :2])
df['Sleep Disorder Fill'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
sleep_disorders = df['Sleep Disorder Fill'].unique()
data_to_plot = [df[df['Sleep Disorder Fill'] == disorder]['Heart Rate'].dropna() for disorder in sleep_disorders]
parts = ax6.violinplot(data_to_plot, positions=range(len(sleep_disorders)), showmeans=True, showmedians=True)
for pc in parts['bodies']:
    pc.set_alpha(0.7)
ax6.set_xticks(range(len(sleep_disorders)))
ax6.set_xticklabels(sleep_disorders)
ax6.set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Heart Rate Distribution by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax6.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 7. Daily Steps vs Sleep Duration
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax7.hexbin(df['Daily Steps'], df['Sleep Duration'], gridsize=15, cmap='YlOrRd', mincnt=1)
ax7.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hrs)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Daily Steps vs\nSleep Duration', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax7.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
